annotations.title: Welch Allyn Ophthalmic Sets | Welch Allyn | Hillrom
Welch Allyn 3.5 V Coaxial Ophthalmoscope | Welch Allyn | Hillrom

content.text:
Welch Allyn / Hillrom ophthalmology tools commonly include:

- **Direct ophthalmoscopes** – for viewing the retina, optic disc, vessels, and red reflex.
  - Examples: **PanOptic Plus Ophthalmoscope**, **3.5 V Coaxial Ophthalmoscope**, **AutoStep Coaxial Ophthalmoscope**.
- **Diagnostic sets** – handle + ophthalmoscope head, often paired with an otoscope for eye/ENT exams.
- **Retinoscopes** – for objective refraction, especially in optometry/ophthalmology training.
- **Spot Vision Screener** – handheld autorefractor/vision screener, often used in pediatrics or primary care.
- **Rechargeable handles and chargers** – 3.5 V power handles, lithium-ion handles, desk chargers, wall systems.
- **Replacement lamps / LED modules / apertures** – depending on the model.

The current flagship-style Welch Allyn ophthalmic set features the **PanOptic Plus ophthalmoscope**, which is designed for a wider fundus view and includes Quick Eye alignment guidance. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/ophthalmic-sets/?utm_source=openai)) Welch Allyn also still lists coaxial ophthalmoscope models with LED illumination and multiple aperture/filter options. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/3-5v-coaxial-ophthalmoscope/?utm_source=openai))

If you’re buying, the main choice is usually:

| Use case | Best fit |
|---|---|
| Medical/PA/nursing school | Basic Welch Allyn diagnostic set or used 3.5 V coaxial set |
| Primary care / general exam room | Wall-mounted diagnostic set or PanOptic/otoscope combo |
| Ophthalmology/optometry training | Retinoscope + ophthalmoscope, often 3.5 V system |
| Pediatric screening | Welch Allyn Spot Vision Screener |
| Mobile exams | Rechargeable handle + PanOptic or coaxial head |

If you tell me whether you’re **buying**, **identifying a tool**, or **looking for instructions/manuals**, I can narrow it down.
